goal: Decide if Emporous lets an object into a namespace. Each object must come from someone who is allowed to add it there.

app.name: emporous-admit-policy
app.title: Emporous admission
app.purpose: Decide whether one representation is admitted under the scope its namespace names, from the scope, its realization, the principal and the bytes.

fields.name: namespace
fields.means: whether the namespace names exactly one scope, none, or more than one

fields.name: realization
fields.means: whether the registry knows the realization the scope names

fields.name: principal
fields.means: whether a capability-edge walk reaches the principal from the scope authorization

fields.name: bytes
fields.means: whether the realization carries the bytes to a canonical form

meanings.permit: XACML 3.0 section 7: Permit; the object kappa, the representation kappa and a DerivedFrom edge are written
meanings.deny: XACML 3.0 section 7: Deny; StoreError::Rejected and no DerivedFrom edge is written
meanings.not-applicable: XACML 3.0 section 7: NotApplicable; the namespace names no scope, so no policy governs it
meanings.indeterminate: XACML 3.0 section 7: Indeterminate; the scope cannot be evaluated, because its realization is unknown or the namespace names several scopes

rules.why: crates/admission/src/scope.rs scope_of_namespace: the namespace names no scope, StoreError::NotFound
crates/admission/src/scope.rs: a namespace naming more than one scope is StoreError::Conflict
crates/admission/src/admit.rs: the registry does not know the realization, StoreError::NotFound (EA-03)
crates/admission/src/admit.rs and auth.rs: the principal is not authorized by the scope capability, StoreError::Rejected (EA-05)
crates/admission/src/realize.rs: the realization refuses the bytes, StoreError::Rejected

app.otherwiseWhy: SPEC.md 5.1: the canonical form is ingested on the scope axis and the received bytes at their own kappa, joined by a DerivedFrom edge

properties.why: EA-05: admission into a namespace requires the capability its scope names
EA-03: a scope naming a realization the registry does not know is reported as not found
admit.rs checks authorization before the realization reads the bytes
without a scope there is no realization, axis or authorization to apply

stakeholders.name: Publisher
stakeholders.text: Admits artefact representations into a namespace and needs each admission addressed by the canonical form its scope selects.

stakeholders.name: Supply-chain auditor
stakeholders.text: Assesses blast radius over ComposedOf and needs every object in a namespace admitted by a principal its capability authorizes.

concerns.name: Authorized admission
concerns.text: No object kappa and no DerivedFrom edge exist for a principal the scope capability does not reach.

components.name: kappa-registry
components.text: The pinned upstream registry Emporous imports, whose KappaStore ingests content and resolves edges.

components.name: KappaStore
components.text: The content-addressed store holding objects, representations, scopes and capability edges.

threats.name: Unauthorized admission
threats.text: A principal outside the scope capability admits an object into the namespace.

control.name: Capability-edge walk
control.text: Admission is denied unless the walk from the scope authorization reaches the principal.

threats.name: Realization chosen in code
threats.text: The admission path names a realization or axis literal instead of reading it from the scope.

control.name: Read from the scope
control.text: The realization and axis are read from the scope and a literal on the admission path fails the gate.

threats.name: Unknown realization admitted
threats.text: A scope names a realization the registry does not know and the bytes are admitted unrealized.

control.name: Not found, not admitted
control.text: An unknown realization is indeterminate and never permitted.

quality.text: No request from an unauthorized principal is permitted.
quality.measureText: Requests with an unauthorized principal that answer permit.

quality.text: Each admission condition of SPEC.md 6.3 and the namespace conflict has its own answer.
quality.measureText: Admission failure conditions no rule decides.
